children: Govt Raises 33K-cr at Weekly Bond Auction Mumbai: The RBI, on behalf of the government, raised 33,000 crores via central government securities in its weekly auction. The auction had papers of 9,000 crores for three years which got a cut off yield of 7.12%, the 12,000 crores paper had a cutoff yield of 7.38% for seven years, while the 9,000 crore paper for 30 years had a cut off yield had 7.84%. IPOs of Punjab Carbonic, 3 Others Get Sebi Nod Mumbai: Punjab Carbonic, Ratnadeep Retail, GNI Infrastructure and Atomberg Technologies have received the Sebi approval to proceed with their IPOs.

Punjab Carbonic's IPO comprises a fresh issue of 60 lakh equity shares and an offer for sale of 35 lakh shares. Ratnadeep Retail to raise up to 400 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares, along with an OFS of up to 1.49 crore shares. GNI Infra's IPO comprises a fresh issue of up to 2.10 crore equity shares and an OFS of 93.88 lakh shares. Atomberg Tech IPO consists of a fresh issue of equity shares up to 450 crore and an OFS of up to 7.65 crore shares.

M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO Subscribed 5 Times Mumbai: The 275-crore IPO of M K Sons Fine Jewels was subscribed 5.09 times on the final day of the bidding on Friday. Non-institutional investors led the demand, subscribing their portion 14.12 times, while the qualified institutional buyers' (QIB) portion was subscribed 1.84 times. Retail individual investors subscribed 3.08 times their allotted portion. - Our Bureau Sebi Fines CDSL 1 cr for Compliance Lapses Mumbai: Markets regulator Sebi on Friday imposed a penalty of 1 crore on Central Depository Services (India) for multiple compliance lapses. CDSL has been directed to pay the penalty within 45 days, failing which recovery proceedings may be initiated.
